card.title: Not sure which plan?
card.text: Send us a week of tickets and we’ll tell you.

items.q: What counts as a resolved conversation?
items.a: One the agent answered end to end: the customer got what they asked for and did not write back about it again. If it hands over to a person at any point in the thread, it is not resolved and it is not billed.

items.q: So we pay nothing for the ones it hands over?
items.a: Nothing. Handovers are the product working as intended — it sorts by urgency, writes the draft and passes the thread across with the history attached. You pay for the ones your team never had to open.

items.q: Is anything billed during the two-week shadow rollout?
items.a: No. For the first two weeks it drafts and you sign, so nothing reaches a customer without you and nothing counts as resolved. The fortnight where it learns your tone costs you nothing.

items.q: Is there a minimum or a setup fee?
items.a: No setup fee on any plan. Starter has no minimum at all, Growth starts at 2,000 resolved a month and Enterprise at 20,000. If you are not reaching the volume, you are on the wrong plan and we will move you down.
The rate per resolved conversation, and nothing else. You are invoiced twelve months up front and keep the same cancellation terms the plan already has. Enterprise is an annual contract either way.
Yes, in both directions, effective from the next invoice. Nothing is reimplemented — the connected inboxes, the help centre sync and the tone it learned from your signed replies all carry across.
